datasets.name: 3ab4e32e
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN period = 'last_30d' THEN corrective_tickets
    END
  ) AS corrective_tickets,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN period = 'prior_30d' THEN corrective_tickets
    END
  ) AS corrective_tickets_prior,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN period = 'last_30d' THEN sla_compliance
    END
  ) AS sla_compliance,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN period = 'last_30d' THEN mttr_hours_median
    END
  ) AS mttr_hours_median
FROM
  workspace.fitco_gold.v_headline_kpis

datasets.name: asset_top25
queryLines:
SELECT
  asset_id,
  club_name,
  model_code,
  SUM(repeat_30d_flag) AS repeat_30d_tickets,
  SUM(corrective_flag) AS corrective_total,
  SUM(downtime_hours) AS downtime_hours
FROM
  workspace.fitco_gold.v_dash_ticket
GROUP BY
  asset_id,
  club_name,
  model_code
ORDER BY
  repeat_30d_tickets DESC
LIMIT 25
SELECT club_id, club_name, city, country, ownership_model, operating_model, maturity FROM workspace.fitco_gold.dim_club;
